title: Wade R NDE 20417
content: I drowned when I was fourteen years old. According to the witnesses and paramedics, I was clinically dead for over fourteen minutes. I saw myself dead as I was looking down at my body and being joined by other spiritual beings. What happened after that is very difficult to put into words. Words just cannot describe what I saw and felt. I was told it was not my time. I was allowed to see so much. And then I was returned to my body.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Clinical death Was drowned.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Life review | Vision of the future | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I felt perfect in every way. I communicated with beings (spiritual guides) without talking. Everything happened at an accelerated pace.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: At first a buzzing sound then everything came into focus. The voices the music the water sounds everything. But in clear definition. Perfect.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes No creatures until after I was returned. But while I was with the spiritual beings it was in heaven.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I met many beings. Some were new to me but others were from eternities before. The three spirit guides were with me most of the time. They came to me as if they were stars and then developed into those who I have known all my life.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes When the spiritual beings took me to him there was light all around each being was within a glow of light. I was within a glow of light and when we touched each other, the light or glow became as one. All surrounding and warm.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm All five senses worked beyond what they do here.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Wow I felt special and I was loved. I wanted to know or to obtain knowledge. I was given that. I was shown things and told things that were just pure
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control To answer this question I would need to write a book. I was taken to places or locations that were out of this world as we see it. I did not need to interact or try to interact with anyone or try to move objects. Everything was one.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I did not want to return. I was shown why I should.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: From the time of death I was joyful. The worst part was when I was recovering and how Satan was displeased with my return.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: The questionnaire is fine. I just have a difficult time describing what happened.
